title: Fix linalg/bwc for General-Purpose Block Wiedemann
summary: A square-matrix workaround sufficed for the reduced-cipher experiment, but resolving the software limitation for general Block Wiedemann use remains open.

formal_statement.body: Diagnose and fix the linalg/bwc padding and matrix-shape issues to obtain a general-purpose implementation of the Block Wiedemann algorithm.

scope.domain: Algebraic-cryptanalysis tooling for Block Wiedemann linear algebra.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Resolve the linalg/bwc padding and matrix-shape issues and obtain a general-purpose Block Wiedemann implementation.

progress.summary: The source reports that a square-matrix workaround was sufficient for the reduced-cipher experiment. It explicitly leaves investigation and resolution of the linalg/bwc issues as an open problem.
citation_labels: Henri Gilbert et al., Cryptanalysis of Elisabeth-4
